outcome.suspended: Mission suspended: the crew is safe in the shelter waiting for rescue.
curiosity.bubble: Hi, neighbours! Today the low is {min} °C. {sky}
terrain.plain.name: Aeolis Plain
terrain.plain.fact: These pebbles are round like river stones: flowing water polished them a very long time ago.
terrain.lakebed.name: Yellowknife Bay
terrain.lakebed.fact: This pale rock formed at the bottom of a lake. There was water here billions of years ago!
terrain.dunes.name: Bagnold Dunes
terrain.dunes.fact: The wind still moves this dark sand: the dunes travel about one meter every year.
terrain.buttes.name: Murray Buttes
terrain.buttes.fact: Each layer of these hills is a page of Mars's history. Some are as tall as a three-story house.
terrain.gediz.name: Gediz Vallis Channel
terrain.gediz.fact: Water and avalanches rushed down this channel. On May 30, 2024, Curiosity crushed a rock and found yellow crystals of pure sulfur inside: nobody had ever seen them on Mars!
rock.conglomerate.name: Conglomerate
rock.conglomerate.fact: Round pebbles stuck together: a river carried and polished them.
rock.mudstone.name: Lake mudstone
rock.mudstone.fact: Mud from the bottom of a lake that turned into stone. The white veins are minerals left by water.
rock.basalticSand.name: Basalt sand
rock.basalticSand.fact: Dark sand made of basalt, a rock born in volcanoes. The wind keeps moving it.
rock.sandstone.name: Layered sandstone
rock.sandstone.fact: Sand piled into dunes by the wind long ago that turned into rock: each stripe is a layer.
rock.sulfur.name: Pure sulfur
rock.sulfur.fact: Yellow crystals of pure sulfur. Curiosity found the first ones on Mars in this channel on May 30, 2024.
crater.title: Gale Crater
crater.subtitle: This is how it looks from the spacecraft that orbit Mars
crater.rim: Crater rim: {km} km from side to side
crater.credit: Real photo: {credit}, pixelated for the game
crater.compressed: From where Curiosity landed to the channel it is {km} km in a straight line. The game shrinks that path: you walk it in a moment, with one strip of each landscape. The blinking cross is you.
realEvent.sulfur.kidValue: On its Martian day number 4200, Curiosity drove over a rock, cracked it open and found yellow crystals of pure sulfur inside.
realEvent.sulfur.explanation: Pure sulfur had never been found on Mars. It only forms in very special conditions: scientists are still working out how it got into this channel.
